author: TeIq
content:
PR 3 closed. The agent's worktree branched off an older base (81e8217); I applied the new polaris-types-side files directly to main (escalation.rs, evidence.rs, lexicon_mapping/{mod.rs, error.rs}, two test files, two fixtures) plus the workspace + crate Cargo.toml deltas (polaris-lexicons + proto-blue-syntax + getrandom + proptest).

## Architect verification (all clean)
- cargo build -p polaris-types — PASS
- cargo clippy -p polaris-types --tests -- -D warnings — PASS
- cargo test -p polaris-types --lib — 54 passed (incl. 3 new lexicon_mapping unit tests)
- cargo test -p polaris-types --test lexicon_mapping_privacy — 7 passed (moderator_id-not-in-wire, EscalationId-stripped, ReportVolumeAnomaly + ModeratorBehaviorAnomaly rejected at boundary, fixture JSON deserializes)
- cargo test -p polaris-types --test lexicon_mapping_roundtrip — 3 proptests × 1000 cases each
- cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p polaris-types — PASS
- RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc -p polaris-types --no-deps — PASS

## Bonus pre-existing fixes
- getrandom 0.4 wasm_js feature gap at workspace level (uuid 1.x pulls getrandom 0.4 via rng-getrandom; explicit `wasm_js` feature needed)
- Broken intra-doc link in polaris-types/src/oauth_config.rs ([`proto_blue::oauth::ClientMetadata`])

## AC results
- [x] AC-3: 1000-case proptest round-trip per record type — PASS
- [x] AC-5: at least one valid Lexicon JSON document per record type round-trips — PASS (sample_escalation.json + sample_evidence_pointer.json)
- [x] Privacy boundary enforced by unit test (REQ-4 / REQ-5)
